test_cases.title: Add three distinct products and remove one while preserving cart state
preconditions: The application is available at the configured test base URL.
A user can establish the authenticated state required by the feature through the visible login flow.
The authenticated product listing exposes at least three selectable products.
test_data_requirements: Use only products currently visible in the authenticated product listing and select exactly three different products at runtime.
Retain the three selected product names as selectedProductNames, retain the removed product name as removedProductName, and retain the other two names as remainingProductNames for later comparisons.
Do not rely on fixed product names; the exploratory observation of Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light is evidence of available runtime data, not a required data set.

steps.action: Authenticate through the visible login flow.
steps.expected_result: The authenticated product listing is displayed.

steps.action: Read the products currently visible in the product listing as visibleProducts.
steps.expected_result: visibleProducts contains the products available for selection in the listing.

steps.action: Select exactly three different products at runtime from visibleProducts and retain their names as selectedProductNames.
steps.expected_result: selectedProductNames contains exactly three distinct product names that were visible in the listing.

steps.action: Add each product in selectedProductNames to the cart.
steps.expected_result: Each selected product is added through the visible product-listing flow.

steps.action: Inspect the visible cart quantity indicator.
steps.expected_result: The cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 3 products.

steps.action: Open the cart through the visible cart entry.
Read the product names visible in the cart as cartProductNames.
steps.expected_result: cartProductNames contains the products currently represented in the cart.
The cart visibly contains the same three distinct product names selected from the listing.

steps.action: Select one product from selectedProductNames as removedProductName and retain the other two as remainingProductNames.
steps.expected_result: removedProductName is one selected product name, and remainingProductNames contains the other two selected product names.

steps.action: Remove removedProductName using its visible cart action.
steps.expected_result: The selected product is removed from the visible cart.

steps.action: Read the product names visible in the cart after removal as postRemovalProductNames.
steps.collection: visible cart product names after removal
steps.expected_result: postRemovalProductNames contains the products currently represented in the cart after the removal.

steps.action: Compare postRemovalProductNames with removedProductName and remainingProductNames.
steps.expected_result: removedProductName is not visible in the cart, and both products in remainingProductNames remain visible.

steps.action: Inspect the visible cart quantity indicator after removal.
steps.expected_result: The cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 2 products.

expected_results: Three distinct products selected at runtime from the authenticated listing are represented in the cart.
The cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 3 products before removal.
After removing one selected product, that product is no longer visible, the other two selected products remain visible, and the cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 2 products.

metadata.evidence_basis: The feature and Discovery specify the complete three-product add/remove flow. Exploration observed authenticated listing access, visible cart representation, and quantity updates for two products, but did not verify the three-product state or the specified post-removal assertions.
